summary: Full backend + frontend test of BiglypEnroll. 21/21 backend pytest tests pass (after 1 test-side fix for email casing). Frontend flows verified: parent login, fee selection, pay-now dialog with mode select, receipt dialog, payment history, financing dialog opens; school_admin analytics dashboard renders 4 KPI cards + collection velocity + payment modes + aging + funnel charts; Fee Structure page has all data-testids and loads; Onboarding wizard renders all 4 steps; Students page lists seeded students. AI CSV parsing endpoint successfully returns structured fee_heads via Emergent LLM.

issues: Radix DialogContent renders without a DialogTitle/Description -- accessibility warnings/errors in console. Non-blocking but should be fixed with VisuallyHidden DialogTitle for screen-reader compliance.

action_items: (Low) Add DialogTitle/DialogDescription (or VisuallyHidden variant) to Pay dialog, Financing dialog, and Receipt dialog in ParentDashboard.js to remove Radix a11y warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a 724-line monolith mixing auth, school, fees, students, parent, analytics, seed. Should be split into routers (auth.py, school.py, fees.py, parent.py, analytics.py) for maintainability.
compute_pending() is called inside a per-student loop in /api/analytics/overview -> N+1 fee_structures.find_one calls; cache fee structure once per request.

get_current_user reads cookie 'access_token' but /auth/login never sets a cookie (only returns token in body). Cookie code path is dead; either drop it or set httpOnly cookie on login for defense-in-depth.
/auth/logout is a no-op returning {ok:true}; if httpOnly cookies are ever added, it must also clear the cookie.
Seed inserts random historical payments only when students collection is empty -- fine for demo but analytics numbers are non-deterministic across fresh DBs.
CORS uses allow_origins='*' with allow_credentials=True; browsers will reject credentialed requests. Set explicit origin (REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL host) if cookie auth is ever enabled.
PayIn.mode is not validated against an enum; any string is accepted and stored in payments.mode -- consider Literal[...] for consistency with analytics mode_split.
No rate limiting / brute-force lockout on /auth/login (playbook expects lockout after 5 fails).
seed_data_creation: Backend startup seed creates Horizon International School, 4 demo users, 6 students (incl. Aarav Sharma linked to parent@biglyp.com), published fee structure, and randomised historical payments. Tests add a couple of TEST_-prefixed rows (student + temporary fee head that is cleaned up).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py, run via `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. All 21 tests currently pass. Frontend routes: /login, /register, /dashboard (staff), /dashboard/fees, /dashboard/students, /dashboard/onboarding, /app (parent), /app/history. Parent flow requires selecting a checkbox first before Pay/Split-EMI buttons enable. The Financing 'confirm-finance-btn' only appears after adjusting tenure inside the dialog.
rca of the issue: N/A -- no functional failures observed. Only Radix a11y console warnings (missing DialogTitle) which are non-blocking; fix by adding <DialogTitle> (optionally wrapped in <VisuallyHidden>) inside each DialogContent.
